modified.name: A job that fails each round is suspended
modified.text: A roadmap job that failed `DEFAULT_SERVICE_MAX_FAILED_ROUNDS` rounds in a row on the same input SHALL NOT run again until its input changes, and a success SHALL clear its count. The input of a round SHALL hold the newest comment that a person made on an Item of the row after the row's last success, and SHALL hold no comment that the Service's own account made. The log line that suspends a job SHALL name the cause of each of those rounds, and a cause of a round that an earlier process counted SHALL read as `unknown`.

scenarios.name: Polls after the limit
scenarios.when: a job has failed its limit of rounds and only polls follow
scenarios.then: the job does not run and the round succeeds

scenarios.name: A person's comment after the limit
scenarios.when: a job has failed its limit of rounds and a person comments on one of its Items
scenarios.then: the job's input differs from the input it failed on, and the job runs again

scenarios.name: The Service's own comment after the limit
scenarios.when: a job has failed its limit of rounds and the Service's account comments on one of its Items
scenarios.then: the job's input is the one it failed on, and the job does not run

scenarios.name: The cause of the suspension
scenarios.when: a job fails three rounds in a row, with the errors `GitHubOperationError`, `RoadmapRefineError` and `GitHubOperationError`
scenarios.then: the log line that suspends the job names those three causes in that order

scenarios.name: A file written by the running version
scenarios.when: the ledger file holds records in the format that the running version writes, and a new process starts over it
scenarios.then: the start succeeds and the ledger holds those records, and the file that the new process writes reads with the type that the running version uses
